caption.en: Transverse view of a confirmed Radiopaedia case showing the target sign; colour Doppler panel at right. Case rID 232928, contributed by Soo Tze Hui. The child was 2 months old, younger than the typical peak age.

selectionRationale: A confirmed pediatric ultrasound case with both transverse and longitudinal frames was visually inspected in the Radiopaedia viewer. It demonstrates the two orientations needed for this focused teaching point. The recorded age is 2 months, below the typical peak; this is disclosed in the transverse caption rather than presented as the canonical age pattern.
